CustomField.description: Expiry of the partner's exemption certificate under §48b EStG. Wallbox and PV installation count as Bauleistungen, so without a valid certificate VoltStream must withhold 15% Bauabzugsteuer from the payment (§48 EStG) - the money comes out of our side, not theirs. This is the one document whose lapse has a direct cash consequence, which is why it blocks invoicing rather than activation.
CustomField.label: Freistellungsbescheinigung gültig bis
